title: 중소기업인력지원 특별법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00341:20060602:00002:part:1/1

Addendum <Ordinance No. 341, June 2, 2006>
These Rules shall enter into force on June 4, 2006. Provided, however, that the amended provisions of Article 2, subparagraph 5, shall enter into force on July 29, 2006.
